calculation.expression: -rolling_sum(residual_return_15d,15)/rolling_mean(asset_volatility_20d,20), active only when residual_dispersion_20d > trailing_120d_dispersion_65th_percentile, lagged one day
calculation.description: Within unusually dispersed cross-asset regimes, ranks assets for contrarian recovery after a volatility-normalized 15-day residual shock versus the equal-weight benchmark. All inputs are lagged before the forward 10-day test.

metrics.decay: 10-day horizon validated; no alternate horizons computed

validation.regime_notes: Regime IC: 2024-2026 0.22659 (72 dates, ICIR 1.0366); 2027-2029 0.00146 (270 dates, ICIR 0.0049); 2030-2032 0.01472 (209 dates, ICIR 0.0628). Strong early regime and weaker later regimes warrant conservative sizing and revalidation.
